speaker: Mr Yee Chia Hsing (Chua Chu Kang)
text: Two, many residents want to have more coffee shops, but few residents understand the inconvenience of staying above the coffeeshop units.

speaker: Mr Yee Chia Hsing (Chua Chu Kang)
text: Some of the visible damage is repaired post the fire incident but residents have actually given feedback that, for example, the floor tiles, it may not be visible right after, and the cracks may appear like six months or a year after.

speaker: Mr Yee Chia Hsing (Chua Chu Kang)
text: Will they then still be able to claim from the coffee shop tenant?

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: If it is, then they can be replaced.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: But if it is many, many years, even a decade down the road, and these things occur, we need to really look at what the cause of it is.
